$comment: The oldest wac compiler this repo is known to work with. A minimum, not an exact
version: a newer checkout is fine and is the normal state.
Only ever move it to a commit the suite has actually passed against — the pin is a
claim, and an unverified claim is worse than none. `deno task wac:pin` records the
sibling checkout's HEAD, which is the right move when you adopt a new compiler
feature; write a reason saying which feature, not the commit's subject line.
See 'Keeping the compiler pin current' in README.md. Checked by
harness/wacVersion.ts on the first wacBind of a run.
reason: trace mode (ctTrace) and the 'index' coverage-point kind, which packages/crypto's constant-time tests need
